evidence_snippets: The following performance tiers are available for both use cases, text query search and browse: Text query search TIER 1 Relevance Results are returned based on degree of relevance to the query, such as how black a dress is when a black dress is queried.
Unlock search performance tiers Text query search and browse search have different performance tiers that increasingly improve your search results.
Ideally, similar to search events, search requests should have either the query (text) and the page category (browse) filled.
